title: Slightly Nicer TrashSlot Icon
description: A tiny resource pack that replaces the default TrashSlot icon with something slightly nicer.
body:
I didn't like the default icon for [TrashSlot](https://modrinth.com/mod/trashslot), so I made this.

I think it's _slightly nicer_. I hope you agree.

Just drop it in your resourcepacks folder and enable it for **good times**.

Requires TrashSlot, obviously.
